decisions: no-op-state-machine: current cast model is pure cooldown auto-cast; no startup/recovery state exists to enhance; any cast-hold/cancel requires new state in GenericSkill (X3 owned) plus UI lane

foundation_mod: feat-tce-context (mods/feat-tce-context) extends TCE on_hit/on_crit contexts with target/did_crit; behavior-zero (optional params, context keys only); depends on feat-tce; only patches Scenes/Stats.gd + Scenes/Skills/GenericSkill.gd (X3 owned)
no-x1-x2-touch: Player.gd (X1), Mob.gd (X2) preimages untouched; no patch path outside Scenes/Stats.gd + Scenes/Skills/GenericSkill.gd
measure-first: per-hit FX/budget tuning deferred to S5 lane (X4) after telemetry; X3 records cost model, does not change gameplay numbers
